quest.title: Bantan Sango Case File: Mystery of the Black Shadow
quest.description: Someone needs to help take up a mysterious case that has come up in Inazuma...

talks.objective: Go to the Adventurers' Guild in Inazuma

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Hello, Traveler. You couldn't have come at a better time...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, Paimon knows where this one's going.

choices.text: Yes, let me guess. Next, you'll say...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Mm, as expected of an experienced adventurer. It is as you say: we do have a new commission that may suit you.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Bantan Sango Detective Agency is in need of manpower, and they requested your help specifically in investigating the "large scale disappearance of many small animals."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Just a couple of small animals?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Aw, come on. You sure something this simple needs our glorious {NICKNAME} to step forward?

choices.text: I mean, even take-out deliveries aren't beneath me...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Actually, isn't Bantan Sango that detective agency? Why would they need to hire adventurers?

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Well, here's the situation: Sango has requested that a highly-experienced adventurer accompany Ryuuji on some investigations.

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: Additionally... Hmm, let me see. Sango requested that I say this:

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: "Many people have had their pets disappear, which has seen many commissions come our way in one go. If this matter can be resolved, a generous bounty shall be guaranteed."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #"A generous bounty," she says...! Hmm, y'know what, {NICKNAME}? Paimon thinks these poor, poor animals deserve to be rescued!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And anyway, commissions great and small are all avenues for self-improvement, aren't they?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're so easily led, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whatever~ Let's go look for Sango!

choices.text: Sure. I've fixed carts in the past, too...
Hey, I mean, I beat Stormterror way back when...

response.speaker: Katheryne
response.text: You consider defeating Stormterror a simple matter? That's... very impressive.

choices.text: Something something, new commission for me?

talks.objective: Go to Bantan Sango Detective Agency

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Pretty good. You arrived more quickly than I thought.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Of course! We came running the moment we heard about the gener— Uh, about the missing animals!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Alright then. What's the issue? Never fear, Paimon and {NICKNAME} are here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Come on, we both know who's gonna do all the work...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon'll cheer for you! That counts for something, right?

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Ah, energetic as always. Well then, here's the issue. We've received a ton of commissions lately concerning lost animals. To the effect that we should find them, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: They're mostly pets of some kind, which means that they really shouldn't have run off by themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Inazuma does have its fair share of strange tales. But everything happens for a reason, and there is nothing that cannot be solved through logic. Our on-scene investigations have borne this axiom out.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Wait, don't you mean "my on-scene investigations"?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ehe, looks like Paimon's gonna have to cheer you on too, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Thanks for the offer, but it's fine.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: I've been on the trail of the missing animals these past few days, and I wound up discovering some encampments out in the wild. Some of them were guarded by monsters — no big deal, really.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: However, just as I was attempting to release some of the trapped animals in one of the camps...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: ...He was taken out by "a dark shadow that suddenly appeared."

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: When I woke up, the camp was empty as a grave.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Tsk, not a good look for our Ryuuji, eh? *sigh* Whatever happened to the Ryuuji who roared like the wicked oni Torachiyo himself as he defeated the perpetrator of the "Sanbongatana Kinpachi" incident?

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Why, and then he held me fast as I feigned death, crying out...

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Wait, stop! Stop, I say!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, come on! What happened next?

choices.text: Let's settle the issue on hand first, shall we?

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Whatever the case, we at Bantan Sango require the aid of an adroit adventurer such as yourself to help us save these animals!

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: As long as you're there, we'll have an eyewitness even if Ryuuji gets knocked out again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, Sango, so why don't you go yourself again?

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Ah, ah, don't forget. I'm the brains of the party here. That's my job — using my brain. As far as I'm concerned, my flesh is but an accessory to my mind.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Whoa, she's lazy, and insistently so, too!)

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Of course, you won't be working for free. You will be paid, just as we agreed.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's what Paimon likes to hear! C'mon, let's go!

choices.text: Ah, Paimon...

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: One moment, if you will. Please take this with you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh... Uh, sorry, what is this thing again?

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: This is the <color=#00E1FFFF>Ubiquity Net</color>. I had a friend make this based on records of Kamuna Onmyoudou.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: It's not strong enough to capture criminals, no, but with a little aim, it should have no problem catching small animals.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: With this, bringing the missing animals back should be a breeze!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Woohoo! Easy-peasy! Thanks, Sango, you're the best!

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: I couldn't call that being "the best." Consider this more "an insurance policy to avoid failure," instead.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Ryuuji, go along with them, would you?

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Certainly.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: I've discovered some more traces of missing animals. Follow me.

choices.text: Well, here we go.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: No problem.

choices.text: Thanks, Sango.
High speed low drag.
Yeah, what happened next?

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Oh ho, are you interested in a case we closed previously? Well, back then, the usually kindly policeman named Kinpachi...

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: P—Please, let's just return to the current issue...

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: ...You know what? Sure. Sorry, Ryuuji.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: According to our current investigations, this should be the place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, there really are a ton of lil' critters here. Did they all go missing?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And this is a... dog?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's a dog guarding this place?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Huh, so that's how it was. Mm... This is embarrassing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? What are you embarrassed about, Ryuuji?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: ...This dog is the "dark shadow" that took me out in one go.

choices.text: Don't worry, maybe it was just a really strong dog.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: There's... no need to comfort me like that. My skills were lacking.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, that upright stance and that high-flown pride...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, doesn't that remind you of someone?

choices.text: Right. Komore Teahouse's...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! Paimon thought about him, too! We even originally thought that he could speak. Shame, though, he really couldn't.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: You speak of Komore Teahouse's owner?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You know of him, Ryuuji?

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Somewhat. They do look similar, to be sure. We shouldn't drop our guard.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Taroumaru is known to be friendly due to his many dealings with humans. But as for this dog, we don't know anything about it. As such, I advise caution.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mmm, point taken, Ryuuji.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: It's just experience talking, that's all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, why would this dog gather all these animals and stand guard over this place? Paimon doesn't get it.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: We may need more leads to figure this out. For now, let's focus on saving these animals. Their owners are starting to panic.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: #This is where you come in, {NICKNAME}. I will handle what comes after you find the animals. I will ensure that they are taken home as soon as possible.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Not gonna team up and attack?

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: We do not yet know if this foe can be beaten with a "team attack."

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: ...Actually, do you have any experience in "stealth"?

choices.text: Well, back when we tried stealing the Holy Lyre der Himmel...

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: ...That... must have been an interesting experience.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Nonetheless, we should be able to rescue the animals if we can safely avoid the guard.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: I've planted some objects that can attract its attention. I hope that they will be of use to you.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Alright then. Let's do this. I will stand guard here.

choices.text: We did avoid capture that one time at the Rite of Descension...
We did tail a certain government official back in Ritou...
Taroumaru.
Huh, so you kinda suck then, eh Ryuuji?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! The dog was just too strong, that's all! Paimon doubts she'd win either, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Very impressive! You really do have some spectacular moves.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hehehe! Piece of cake for our {NICKNAME}, don'cha know?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Well, then. On to our next target.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait. There's more?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: There's more. If the number of commissions Sango received is no exaggeration, this must be the biggest disappearance of small animals in Inazuma's history.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: I say this, but even without history as our judge, having this many small animals disappear at once is simply abnormal.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: I did follow the trails I detected to other areas, and I found trapped animals there, too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Stealth required?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Not this time.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: The opponents there should be no match for your skills. You'll know when you get there.

talks.objective: Head to the other investigation site

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Thank you very much. You've been a big help.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Right? {NICKNAME}'s the strongest there is!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Does the number of animals tally up now?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: One moment... Huh. There's still some missing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? But how...

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: I'd hardly consider this a loss. We weren't taken out by our Black Shadow, and we managed to get a number of animals back.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: As such, our investigation's making progress. We're just out of leads for the time being.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Let me tell you what. I'll keep investigating. You keep doing what you usually do for a while... Let's meet up at Bantan Sango Detective Agency once something new comes up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, it's not as if we've got better options.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: #Do you need anything, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: About the Ubiquity Net...

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Ah, that. Well, I was originally going to have Ryuuji use it.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: It's not as if our work isn't dangerous, you know? Ryuuji's been injured several times before. So I was thinking — how do I extend the range at which we can capture criminals?

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: I read a lot of old books and wound up designing this net, even commissioning a friend to construct it. In the end, however, "catching small animals" was as far as we got...

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: But whatever the case, it's come to good use in your hands, so that's a plus.

choices.text: You know, I'm curious about what happened with Sanbongatana Kinpachi...

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Ooh, so you're curious about that, huh? Well, here's what happened...

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: ...Actually, you know what? Never mind. If Ryuuji's that opposed to me discussing that matter, I'll refrain.

choices.text: I should be heading off.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Please do. Stay safe!

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Leave what comes after the animals are found to me. I will take them home as soon as possible.

choices.text: What can you tell me about the Black Shadow?

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: I've heard tell of a secret organization that trains ninken, or ninja dogs.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: They say that one such dog, code-named Inujin, destroyed countless monsters that threatened Inazuma in the shadows...

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: ...Of course, this is just a legend. Still, I wonder if this Black Shadow could be the legendary ninken...

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Whatever. I shouldn't make excuses for my defeat...

choices.text: So, tell me about those distractions you set up...

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: I was unable to save the animals while evading its case, but while I was casing the joint, I did find the time to place a few smoke dispensers nearby.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: If you activate these mechanisms, should be able to temporarily divert its attention. I hope that they will help.

choices.text: I'll be back soon.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Good, thank you. I will stand guard here.
